text: > **Scope this task to the money-critical spine only** (later Phase-1 items — backend selection policy, the `PaymentPort` adapter move, the full action namespace, the `"wallet"` projection — are follow-on PRs under #2864, do not build them here): [...] > **Process (mandatory):** this is money-handling code — get a **codex problem/solution design first** (crate module layout + the journal/saga/trail split) before implementing. Work in an **isolated worktree**, branch + **PR** (never push master). Scope tests to `cargo test -p nmp-wallet -p nmp-nip60` plus `cargo test -p nmp-testing --test doctrine_lint_smoke`; do **not** run `cargo test --workspace`. Run **codex review on your diff before opening the PR**; promote any actionable findings to a GitHub issue and discard the review artifact (never commit it). Open a ready-for-review PR (TLDR + detailed overview + tradeoffs), reference #2864, clean up the worktree when done. [...] > **Hard invariants (from the design doc + #2864 — treat as acceptance criteria):** reducer is **confluent** (a NIP-09 delete arriving before its `kind:7375` tombstones, not no-ops); the ring is **never a rebuild authority** (restart rebuilds from Nostr + saga reconcile via a `StateRebuilt` genesis fact); durable causal tier is **`kind:7376` + token `del` fields**, not a local store; **type-level privacy** (no proofs/secrets/keys in any `WalletFact`, log, or projection); `nmp-core` learns **no** Cashu/nutzap/NWC/mint nouns; proof-set derivation is actor-owned, **not** on Trellis (Trellis is acquisition-layer only). Prove confluence and restart-reconcile with tests (out-of-order delete, mint-probe-found-spent, crash-after-`MintSettled`).
